summary: Comprehensive testing of Mango Health Labs and Orange Pharmacy order syncing flows, pay_later booking, staff portal functionality, and payment link auto-send features. All 12 backend API tests passed. UI testing confirmed both staff portals are accessible and functional.
critical_code_review_comments: Route naming inconsistency: Staff portal routes use /mango-staff and /pharmacy-staff, but originally tested with /staff/mango which 404s. User documentation should clarify correct routes.
Both Mango and Orange staff portals correctly implement auto-send payment link logic on status update (sample_collected for Mango, packing for Orange)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Payment link flows for both Mango Health Labs and Orange Pharmacy are working correctly. Backend APIs verified: staff login, view bookings/orders, update status, create payment link. UI staff portals accessible at /mango-staff and /pharmacy-staff (NOT /staff/mango or /staff/orange). Auto-send payment link triggers: Mango on 'sample_collected', Orange on 'packing' status change.

Mango Health Labs.auto_send_payment_link: IMPLEMENTED - Triggers on sample_collected for pay_later bookings

Orange Pharmacy.auto_send_payment_link: IMPLEMENTED - Triggers on packing for pay_later orders

Payment Link Generation.pharmacy_link: PASS - Creates checkout URL with correct format

booking_flow_notes: Mango lab test booking available at /mango with Pay Later option (data-testid='payment-pay-later'). Form requires name, phone, email(optional), address for home collection. Payment method selection appears after filling details.
